event.title: Boyos Wonderland x INI Movement Present: Summer Jam
event.description: A full day that starts with live jam energy in the sun, builds into DJ sets, opens up on the dancefloor, and keeps moving indoors after 23:00. Line-up and tickets announced soon.

concept: Summer Jam doesn't start with a headline. It starts with a live jam in the sun: open, participatory, warm. People finding the rhythm together before a single DJ has touched the decks.
From there the energy builds. Live music gives way to DJ sets. The dancefloor opens gradually as afternoon moves toward evening.
When the garden closes at 23:00, the night doesn't stop. The party continues indoors till late: a natural extension of a day that has been building since the first note.
No big headline, no manufactured hype. Just a full day that earns its dancefloor.

dayArc.name: Live Jam — Open Air
dayArc.description: Participatory live music in the sun. The day starts loose, warm, and open.

dayArc.name: DJ Sets — Garden Stage
dayArc.description: Live energy transitions into DJ sets. The groove deepens as afternoon shifts into evening.

dayArc.name: Indoor Afterparty — Till Late
dayArc.description: The garden closes, the night continues. The same energy moves indoors and keeps going.
